segments.name: Space and Defense
segments.description: Designs and manufactures precision motion and fluid controls for space and defense applications, including satellites, launch vehicles and defense components.
segments.evidence: Within Space and Defense, we had higher orders across our satellite and launch vehicle programs, as well as for defense component programs.

segments.name: Military Aircraft
segments.description: Supplies precision flight controls and control systems for military aircraft OEM production and aftermarket programs.
segments.evidence: Sales increased in military OEM programs $63 million, driven by the ramp-up of activity on the MV-75 program and new production programs.

segments.name: Commercial Aircraft
segments.description: Provides precision flight controls and control systems for commercial aircraft OEM and aftermarket customers.
segments.evidence: Commercial aftermarket sales increased $68 million, driven largely by strong fleet utilization on the 787 and A350 programs.

segments.name: Industrial
segments.description: Supplies industrial precision controls and medical devices for energy, simulation, automation and medical markets.
segments.evidence: The twelve-month backlog in Industrial increased due to increased orders in medical and liquid cooling pumps used in data centers.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including aerospace and defense primes and industrial and medical customers, pay Moog for precision motion and fluid control products and systems, with revenue recognized from confirmed orders over time.
revenueModel.evidence: Our twelve-month backlog represents confirmed orders we believe will be recognized as revenue within the next twelve months.

changes.text: In 2025, Industrial divested businesses, primarily within industrial automation, and Commercial Aircraft sold a non-core product line as part of portfolio shaping activities.
changes.evidence: Industrial net sales decreased in 2025 compared to 2024, driven by divestitures, primarily within industrial automation, and lower sales for flight simulation systems and test products.
